# XP wallpaper pack

Source: https://github.com/storef/windows-xp.themepack
Revision: ec4fb5578d78783c5aed10f39a9917132b6d60ea

The 20 JPEG files in app/src/main/assets/wallpapers/xp are unmodified copies
of the source repository’s 800x600 collection (Autumn is 940x705 there).
Its MIT license is retained in LICENSE. The source collection credits
https://tjkelly.com/blog/windows-xp-desktop-backgrounds/.

Windows and the depicted branding remain the property of their owners.
Nth Desktop is an independent Android project. Audio files and the duplicate
high resolution Azul image are not included.
